brand_notes: Concept 300 is the flagship standmount, sold only with Tensegrity stands and sprung isolation base; gloss lacquer plus veneer, Gelcore multilayer cabinet (mfr-, stereophile-). US price rose from 4499.99 (2020) to 6399. Concept 30 is the smaller sibling at 1799. Maker's min-impedance figure has varied (3.7 / 4.7 ohm).
